entries.title: Still tying the turban as court closes
entries.literal_meaning: While tying the turban, the court closes.
entries.explanation: The repeated tying phrase keeps preparation in progress while the court closes. The dictionary places the line under an office or court stopping work, not dismissal from a job. Our reading notices an opportunity ending before preparation finishes. The line does not say why the person took time, identify their role, or establish a particular court schedule.
entries.meaning_odia: ପାଗ ବାନ୍ଧିବା ଚାଲିଥିବା ବେଳେ କଚିରି ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି କଚିରିର କାମ ବନ୍ଦ ହେବା ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି, ଚାକିରିରୁ ବାହାରିବା ଅର୍ଥରେ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ସରିବା ଆଗରୁ ସୁଯୋଗ ସରିଯାଏ। କାହିଁକି ସମୟ ଲାଗିଲା, ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ପଦ କଣ ବା କଚିରିର ସମୟସୂଚୀ କିପରି—ଉତ୍ସ ତାହା କହେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading contrasts unfinished preparation with a closing opportunity.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠରେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ଅସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ସୁଯୋଗ କିନ୍ତୁ ସରିଲାଣି।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଜଣେ ଫର୍ମଟି ସଜାଉଥିବା ବେଳେ ଆବେଦନ ସମୟ ସରିଗଲା। ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଥର ପାଇଁ ସେ ଆଗୁଆ ତାରିଖ ଲେଖିରଖିଲେ। / Someone misses an application deadline while arranging the form, then plans ahead for the next one. This scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The turban and court remain the source image. No community identity, dress requirement, historical incident or deliberate procrastination is established; the modern deadline application is editorial.

entries.title: Naming the rain amid the flood
entries.literal_meaning: The house is flooded, the water knee-deep; the one-eyed person says it is raining in torrents.
entries.explanation: The house and knee-deep water show a consequence; the speaker names the rain. The dictionary explicitly glosses torrential rain, not a light shower. Our reading asks whether naming an event is enough when its effects need attention. We reject using the quoted disability label to explain anyone’s judgment: the line supplies no evidence that impaired sight causes such a response.
entries.meaning_odia: ଘର ବୁଡ଼ି ପାଣି ଆଣ୍ଠୁଏ; ବକ୍ତା ବର୍ଷାର କଥା କହୁଛନ୍ତି। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଦୁଲୁକିବା ଅର୍ଥ ପ୍ରବଳ ବର୍ଷା, ଅଳ୍ପ ବର୍ଷା ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପାଠ ପଚାରେ: ପ୍ରଭାବକୁ ଦେଖି କାମ କରିବା ଦରକାର ବେଳେ ଘଟଣାର ନାମ କହିବା ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ କି? ଉତ୍ସର ଦୃଷ୍ଟିସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ତାଚ୍ଛଲ୍ୟକୁ ଆମେ ବିଚାରଶକ୍ତିର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଭାବେ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରୁନାହୁଁ। ଏପରି ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାର କାରଣ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିବାଧା ବୋଲି ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ପ୍ରମାଣ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading attends to consequences without endorsing the disability taunt.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ପ୍ରଭାବକୁ ଦେଖେ, ଦୃଷ୍ଟିବାଧା ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ତାଚ୍ଛଲ୍ୟକୁ ସମର୍ଥନ କରେନାହିଁ।

entries.cultural_context: The critical response is editorial, not a supplied traditional counter-moral. No actual flood, medical assessment or disability-group trait is documented; other senses concern vibration and fear.
